      "snippet": "It’s running locally on your Android phone inside Termux, not “in the cloud,” and not on your Windows PC—unless you separately copy/install it there.
What’s actually happening on your phone
When you run commands like mbsl, mbhealth, etc., Termux is executing:

Shell scripts stored at:
/$PREFIX/bin/mbsl and /$PREFIX/bin/mbhealth
(that’s Termux’s local “bin” directory)

A Python file stored at:
~/.metablooms/state_logger/state_logger.py

A log file stored at:
~/.metablooms/state_logger/state.log
